name: @huddle/controller
description: Huddle Controller app: the phone client every player joins a room with.
//scripts: The Controller runs its Metro on 8082; the TV keeps the default 8081. A game needs both apps up at once, and a debug build asks whichever port it was built against for its bundle — so left on the same port the phone silently loads the *television's* bundle and draws a shrunken pairing screen. Nothing errors, which is what makes it expensive to spot. RCT_METRO_PORT is the one the native build bakes in, so it has to be set on `ios` as well, and the two must agree. LC_ALL is CocoaPods 1.17 on Ruby 4, which crashes in `Pod::Config#installation_root` without a UTF-8 locale — the same reason the TV sets it, and the only one of the TV's two variables this app needs.
